style: Single Kalistar equipment asset. Detailed narrative heroic fantasy painting, visible brushwork and painted material planes, hierarchical edges, tactile worn metal, leather and cloth. Not photorealistic, not smooth 3D, not comic ink or anime. Entire object visible with generous margins. No people, hands, text, numbers, interface, borders, watermark or unrelated equipment.

objects.name: Fouet de Selina
objects.flavour: La ville tient au bout d'un fil.
objects.lore: Selina vérifie la tresse avant de retrouver les toits. Ce cuir usé connaît les corniches et les portes fermées. Il ne choisit pas son camp à sa place ; il lui laisse une seconde pour le faire.
objects.object: Catwoman's black braided leather bullwhip, compact straight leather-wrapped grip with silver endcap, long elegant lash arranged in a loose oval coil.
objects.scene: Coiled on a rain-damp stone rooftop ledge, a quiet distant Gotham roofline, soft violet dusk reflection. No gems or extra gear.
objects.ring: black braided leather insets between worn silver and copper rails, tiny violet seam

objects.name: Fusil Cryogénique
objects.flavour: Arrêter le monde, pas son espoir.
objects.lore: Victor resserre le collier du canon avec une patience de chercheur. Le givre gagne le métal. Chaque intervention devait être la dernière ; au fond du laboratoire, Nora attend toujours.
objects.object: Mr Freeze's iconic fictional bulky cryogenic ray rifle, straight cylindrical silver steel barrel, large concentric cooling muzzle, dark charcoal grip and stock, enclosed pale cyan coolant chamber, small red indicator, no realistic ammunition or instructional diagrams.
objects.scene: Resting diagonally on a frost-dusted laboratory bench, one out-of-focus insulated conduit in the background, cold white work light. Whole rifle and straight barrel visible.
objects.ring: brushed frost silver heat-sink segments, dark graphite joints and fine pale cyan inner light

objects.name: Lame de la Ligue
objects.lore: Ra's al Ghul essuie la lame avant de la ranger. Les hommes qui lui jurèrent fidélité ont changé, jamais la précision de ce geste. L'acier ne lui promet pas un monde meilleur ; il porte le poids de celui qu'il veut imposer.
objects.object: Ra's al Ghul's elegant long straight double-edged sword, bright worn silver blade, restrained antique gold crossguard, dark green leather grip and small emerald pommel. Fine ancient workmanship, a proper straight long sword, not a curved scimitar.
objects.scene: Leaning beside a low carved stone seat in a quiet League sanctuary, a narrow strip of forest-green cloth and distant cool daylight. Pull back to keep entire blade straight and visible.
objects.ring: aged gold segments with engraved geometric sword bevels, dark emerald enamel insets

objects.name: Parapluie de l'Iceberg
objects.lore: Cobblepot lisse le tissu noir comme s'il attendait seulement la pluie. L'argent du pommeau ne porte aucune empreinte. À l'Iceberg, la courtoisie est un langage dont il conserve toujours le dernier mot.
objects.object: The Penguin's iconic fictional weapon umbrella, closed long black silk canopy on a perfectly straight dark shaft, elegant silver hooked handle with small bird-head carving, discreet stylized mechanical muzzle at tip, no exposed mechanism diagram.
objects.scene: Leaning against a dark walnut coat stand in the Iceberg Lounge, restrained ivory floor reflection, soft warm lamp off frame. Entire closed umbrella visible, sparse background.
objects.ring: polished aged silver umbrella-rib engravings and black silk panels with subtle champagne highlights

objects.name: Canne du Dernier Rire
objects.lore: Le Joker fait rouler la canne entre ses doigts avant d'entrer. Un éclat manque au sourire du pommeau. Il l'aime ainsi : même une plaisanterie parfaitement préparée doit garder quelque chose de travers.
objects.object: The Joker's theatrical walking cane, perfectly straight slender purple lacquer shaft, worn gold end ferrule and small ivory grinning jester-head pommel with subdued green cap detail. One coherent elegant object, no person, no floating head.
objects.scene: Resting diagonally across the edge of a worn theatre chair, single faded plum curtain behind, one narrow warm stage-light beam. Whole cane visible, restrained atmosphere.
objects.ring: dark plum lacquer segments, aged gold rails and small muted green diamond enamel

objects.name: Armure du Chevalier Noir
objects.flavour: Se relever avant que la ville cède.
objects.lore: Alfred a réparé la couture que Bruce prétendait ne pas sentir. Sous les plaques sombres, les traces des nuits précédentes restent visibles. Cette armure ne le rend pas invulnérable ; elle lui permet de revenir.
objects.object: Batman's recognizable dark graphite armored torso Batsuit, compact chest-and-shoulder protective piece without head or wearer, layered charcoal plates, subtle raised bat chest emblem, worn black textile joins. No body, arms, cape or pedestal.
objects.scene: Hung securely on a simple repair bracket in the Batcave, sparse stone background and warm work light revealing scuffs. No mannequin, no person, no other equipment.
objects.ring: layered graphite armor segments, fine steel bevels and restrained warm brass locking points

objects.name: Scaphandre Cryogénique
objects.flavour: Un hiver pour garder une promesse.
objects.lore: Le joint du col doit rester impeccable. Victor le vérifie encore, puis écoute le souffle régulier du circuit. Ce froid qui l'isole des autres est aussi ce qui lui laisse le temps de poursuivre.
objects.object: Mr Freeze's fictional cryogenic protective upper suit, broad pale steel shoulder collar and armored chest, empty transparent dome helmet, frost-cyan coolant seams and dark flexible joints, compact coherent torso piece with no wearer, no head or limbs.
objects.scene: Secured to a spare maintenance rack in a quiet cold laboratory, faint frost on glass dome, cool daylight and a single muted red standby lamp. No human silhouette or extra props.
objects.ring: thick brushed silver insulated panels, ice-glass edges and small subdued red fasteners

objects.name: Lunettes de Selina
objects.flavour: Voir une issue là où tout se ferme.
objects.lore: Selina passe le pouce sur une rayure du verre. La ville est différente derrière ces lentilles : les ombres y ont des bords, les fenêtres une distance. Elle sait déjà où poser le prochain pied.
objects.object: Catwoman's iconic compact cat-eye night-vision goggles, two deep amber-red oval lenses in black leather and gunmetal frame with slight pointed upper corners, short attached black strap. No head, mask, ears or person.
objects.scene: Set on a low rain-wet brick parapet beside a simple folded black cloth, distant pale window light, quiet rooftop background. Lenses readable, not glowing explosions.
objects.ring: black leather and brushed gunmetal ocular segments with restrained amber glass accents

objects.name: Masque de l'Épouvantail
objects.flavour: Il garde son souffle. Pas ses remords.
objects.lore: Crane replace le filtre sous la toile grossière. Derrière les coutures, l'air doit rester parfaitement calme. Il connaît trop bien ce que ses expériences font aux autres pour vouloir en respirer le moindre souvenir.
objects.object: Scarecrow's recognizable empty worn burlap fear mask, narrow dark eye holes, crooked stitched mouth, subtle small antique metal respirator filter below, rough tan-grey cloth with dark leather straps. No face or wearer, no gore, no gas cloud.
objects.scene: Resting on an old wooden laboratory stool, one plain unmarked glass bottle far behind, dusty side daylight through a narrow window. Sparse sober composition, readable burlap stitches.
objects.ring: coarse burlap insets sewn into patinated iron and copper rails, tiny muted amber filter vents

objects.name: La Pièce de Harvey
objects.flavour: Le métal décide de ce qu'il tait.
objects.lore: Harvey retourne la pièce et reconnaît chaque entaille. Il dit que le hasard est juste. Pourtant, avant de la lancer, sa main se referme toujours un peu trop longtemps.
objects.object: Two-Face Harvey Dent's signature old silver coin, single large silver coin shown at shallow angle with generic worn classical profile relief and deep diagonal scratches across half its face. No readable letters or numbers, no duplicate coin.
objects.scene: Standing slightly tilted against the corner of a closed dark leather case on worn courthouse wood, half warm lamplight and half cool daylight. No gun, hand or extra objects.
objects.ring: one half polished silver and one half scratched dark silver segments, narrow copper edge

objects.name: Le Dernier Point d'Interrogation
objects.condition: Après un nouveau buff physique accordé.
objects.lore: Le Sphinx referme le petit coffret avec un sourire contrarié. Il a trouvé la solution avant tout le monde. Il lui reste à décider qui aura le droit de s'en servir.
objects.object: A small Riddler-inspired mechanical puzzle box, emerald enamel cube with fine aged brass sliding seams and a single engraved gold question mark on its lid. Tangible sophisticated handheld puzzle, no digital screen, no other text.
objects.scene: On a neat dark green felt desk mat, one subdued square of window light, quiet paneled wall beyond. Box slightly opened by one notch, no floating elements or busy puzzle background.
objects.ring: emerald enamel sliding puzzle segments in worn brass, small offset mechanical notches

objects.name: La Dernière Graine
objects.condition: Après une nouvelle potion ou un Reraise.
objects.flavour: Une vie minuscule réclame sa place.
objects.lore: Ivy protège cette graine dans le creux d'une capsule. Elle ne vient d'aucun jardin que Gotham ait su conserver. Quand la coque s'entrouvre, quelque chose de fragile recommence à demander de la place.
objects.object: A Poison Ivy-inspired precious living seed relic, one small luminous green seed with two tiny fresh leaves held inside an open old copper-and-glass botanical capsule, fine organic vine clasp. No poison bottle, skull, person or giant plant.
objects.scene: On a cracked greenhouse sill beside a little moss, soft daylight through quiet pale green glass, restrained natural setting. Seed and capsule remain large and fully readable.
objects.ring: living green leaf veins woven through old copper rails, tiny reddish rosewood joints

objects.name: Ceinture de la Dernière Issue
objects.flavour: Toujours prévoir le retour des autres.
objects.lore: Bruce recompte les compartiments avant de partir. Alfred lui rappelle qu'il ne peut pas tout prévoir. Il le sait ; il veut seulement qu'au moment critique, quelqu'un ait encore une issue.
objects.object: Batman's iconic compact utility belt in worn ochre brass and dark golden leather, rectangular central clasp and six small closed rectangular pouches on a short loosely curved belt. No batarangs, weapons or exposed tools, no person or logo.
objects.scene: Laid on a simple dark stone workbench in the Batcave, a soft warm workshop light on the worn pouches, distant quiet rock texture only. Entire belt visible.
objects.ring: aged brass compartment-like segments with dark leather seams and small square clasps

objects.name: Mémoire de Lazare
objects.flavour: Survivre ne rend pas ce qui est perdu.
objects.lore: Ra's conserve un peu de l'eau verte dans un flacon scellé. Il a vu tant de fidèles tomber qu'il prétend ne plus les compter. Le verre serré dans sa paume dit autre chose.
objects.object: A Ra's al Ghul Lazarus Pit inspired small sealed relic vial, clear green glass with softly luminous emerald water, old engraved gold cage and dark jade stopper, understated ancient craftsmanship. One closed vial, no syringe, no skull.
objects.scene: Resting in a shallow old stone niche near a calm green reflecting pool, warm rim daylight, sparse sanctuary background, tangible glass and liquid clearly visible.
objects.ring: old gold engraved stone-like segments, deep jade glass insets and fine green inner glimmer
